Supports with various configurations and materials.
Temperatures range from 6.5 to 24 inches in size.
Materials include CS30 and SS38.
Load cases vary from Rigid +Y to User Design VSH.
Some supports require updates for forces, moments, or distances.
Se listan varios códigos y descripciones de productos.
Incluye partes como General Shoes, Microtherm Sheet y Round bar.
Hay referencias a diferentes códigos de producto como P01, P10, T01, etc.
Los códigos de producto siguen un formato específico (Ej: 252-HTF-16F-S-009A_P01).
Se mencionan varios códigos de productos repetidos con diferentes partes.
Document status: Critical
Revision history includes dates and purposes
Notes provide axis and orientation references for springs
Spring definitions should use equal or lower spring rates
Vendor modifications to design parameters must be approved by EPC responsible
Data for normal and max operations are provided
Support names include height, type, rate, cold load, hot load, and comments
